gradeDescription: A = I excelled at everything I did today!
noteworthyComments: Today at daycare, I practiced lots of impulse control with a fun game called Red Light, Green Light! It took all my focus to stop when asked, but I worked hard and did a great job. After our training session, it was time for some well-earned fun! I spent the rest of the day playing with my friends, splashing in the pool, and soaking up all the excitement. What a pawsome day of learning and play! My bestie was Ruby today, we had a blast playing
